qualifier: fertilization, transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Fertilization, germline transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members span gamete formation, acrosome reaction and sperm-egg binding, piRNA/KRAB/HUSH retroelement silencing, imprinting and the maternal-to-zygotic handover; fertilization, transposon silencing and zygotic reprogramming separate it from the sperm-motility and meiosis confusables.

qualifier: RIG-I-like and cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing via TRAF-IRF activation
name: Antiviral RIG-I-like receptor signaling to IRF-driven type I interferon
rationale: All members concern cytosolic viral RNA/DNA sensing that activates TRAF3/TRAF6-IRF3/7 and NF-kB to produce type I interferon; the positive-induction arm (IRF activation, IFN-alpha/beta production, viral evasion) distinguishes it from confusables centred on negative regulation of RIG-I or TBK1 control.

qualifier: with inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis
name: PTEN-AKT signaling and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Members cover PTEN regulation and loss, AKT activation and targets, restraint of PI3K/IGF/ERBB signaling, and nuclear/cytosolic inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis; this PTEN-AKT-inositol combination separates it from confusables about serine phosphorylation, pyrophosphate hydrolysis or PAK-2p34.

qualifier: collagen and elastic fibre synthesis and degradation
name: Collagen and elastic fibre matrix synthesis and degradation
rationale: All members concern ECM constituents, collagen and elastin biosynthesis, crosslinking, fibre assembly and MMP-mediated degradation; this turnover focus distinguishes it from confusables centred on EMT, integrin adhesion or basement membrane assembly.

qualifier: immunoregulatory IL-10, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-37
name: Immunoregulatory interleukin signaling: IL-10, IL-27, IL-35, IL-37
rationale: Members are signaling by the anti-inflammatory cytokines IL-10, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-37 plus their autocrine and receptor-binding restraint; these specific immunosuppressive cytokines separate it from confusables built on IL-12/IL-23, interferons or STAT-cytokine networks.

qualifier: 3'-end maturation of rRNA, snRNA and snoRNA
name: Exosome 3'-to-5' RNA trimming, maturation and surveillance
rationale: Members are 3'-to-5' exonucleolytic activities of the RNA exosome: 5.8S rRNA, U4 snRNA and snoRNA 3'-end trimming, rRNA/mRNA decay and tRNA surveillance; the 3'-end maturation of stable RNAs distinguishes it from the nuclear RNA decay confusable and the rRNA transcription/cleavage confusables.

qualifier: entry, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: HIV-1 entry, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover HIV binding, uncoating, reverse transcription, Env/Vpu synthesis and Nef/Vpu-driven degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC I, plus host restriction; early life-cycle steps and receptor downregulation separate it from confusables about PD-L1, integration or MHC I antigen presentation.

qualifier: reelin-guided neuronal migration, lamination and axon tracts
name: Reelin-guided cortical neuron migration, lamination and axon tracts
rationale: Members concern radial glia, radial and tangential neuronal migration, cortical layer formation and commissural/corticospinal tract morphogenesis; reelin signaling and dendrite growth are what the theme has and the forebrain-patterning confusables lack.

qualifier: kinesin and Miro motors with ER tubular network shaping
name: Microtubule motor organelle transport and ER tubular network shaping
rationale: Members cover kinesin- and RHOT/Miro-driven transport of mitochondria, vesicles and receptors in axons and dendrites together with ER tubule formation, fusion and organelle tethering; this combination separates it from confusables on microtubule severing, tubulin modification, ER lipid transfer or Golgi traffic.

qualifier: apical and basolateral surface delivery
name: Polarized epithelial protein delivery to apical and basolateral surfaces
rationale: Members concern apical protein localization, apical surface genes, basolateral secretion, Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport and anion transport regulation; polarized surface delivery distinguishes it from confusables centred on CFTR disease, bile-lipid flippases or exocyst/GLUT4 translocation.

qualifier: by MRAS-SHOC2 complex
name: MRAS-SHOC2 complex-mediated RAF activation
rationale: All three members describe RAF activation by the MRAS-SHOC2-phosphatase complex, including its gain- and loss-of-function mutants; this upstream MRAS-SHOC2 step separates it from confusables on BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K mutants and ERK feedback.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and elongation
qualifier: promoter escape and pausing, including HIV-1 Tat
name: RNA polymerase II initiation and pausing, including HIV-1 Tat
rationale: Members cover Pol II preinitiation, promoter escape, CTD phosphorylation and capping, promoter-proximal pausing and early elongation, much of it in the HIV Tat context; Pol II specificity separates it from the Pol I/III rRNA confusables and its initiation/pausing focus from the chromatin and translation confusables.

qualifier: neuron differentiation and photoreceptor outer segment maintenance
name: Retinal neuron differentiation and photoreceptor outer segment maintenance
rationale: Members concern differentiation of rods, cones, bipolar and amacrine cells, retinal lamination and photoreceptor outer segment/transition-zone organization and maintenance; this distinguishes it from confusables on general ciliary trafficking, eye morphogenesis or phototransduction.

qualifier: isoform-specific ligand activation and activating mutants
name: FGFR isoform-specific ligand activation, oncogenic mutants and adaptor cascades
rationale: All members are FGFR1-4 ligand binding by IIIb/IIIc splice isoforms, activating point mutants and downstream FRS/SHC/PLC/PI3K cascades; isoform-specific activation and mutants distinguish it from confusables featuring Klotho co-receptors or Sprouty/negative regulation.

qualifier: calcium-cAMP-CREB signaling and spine growth
name: Calcium-cAMP-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and spine growth
rationale: Members link calcium-stimulated adenylate cyclase and CaMKII/IV to CREB phosphorylation with LTP/LTD, synaptic translation, maturation and spine morphogenesis; the cAMP-CREB arm and structural plasticity distinguish it from confusables built on NMDA/AMPA receptor signaling and NPAS4.

qualifier: aldosterone and cortisol production in blood pressure control
name: Aldosterone and cortisol synthesis regulation in blood pressure control
rationale: Members concern regulation of mineralocorticoid/glucocorticoid biosynthesis, aldosterone secretion and response, and renin-angiotensin blood pressure control; hormone-synthesis regulation separates it from renal sodium-handling confusables, and the blood-pressure context from steroidogenic-enzyme defect confusables.

qualifier: vasopressin-regulated
name: Vasopressin-regulated renal water reabsorption and antidiuresis
rationale: All members concern vasopressin action and its defects in renal water absorption, urine concentration and responses to water deprivation; vasopressin control distinguishes it from renin-angiotensin, aldosterone and passive aquaporin transport confusables.

qualifier: host-cell invasion and subversion of phagosome maturation
name: Intracellular bacterial invasion and subversion of phagosome maturation
rationale: Members cover Listeria and Mtb attachment and entry, phagosome acidification and phagolysosome fusion, and pathogen blockade of these, of autophagy, apoptosis and NO; this phagosome-subversion focus distinguishes it from toxin-uptake and complement/antimicrobial-peptide confusables.

qualifier: by RHOF GTPase
name: RHOF GTPase control of filopodium assembly
rationale: Members are the RHOF GTPase cycle and positive and negative regulation of filopodium assembly; RHOF-driven filopodia distinguish it from dendrite-arborization, ephrin and postsynaptic actin confusables.

qualifier: ISG signature with feedback restraint and Dengue modulation
name: Type I interferon signature and Dengue-modulated antiviral response
rationale: Members are type I IFN/IRF2-target response signatures, innate antiviral response, negative regulation of RIG-I and antiviral defense, and Dengue modulation of immunity and apoptosis; the downstream signature with feedback and Dengue context separate it from confusables centred on sensor-driven IFN induction or ISG effector mechanisms.

qualifier: Ca2+ branch in retinal vasculature and blood-neural barriers
name: Non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling in retinal vasculature and blood-neural barriers
rationale: Members combine WNT5A/Ca2+ non-canonical signaling and FZD internalization with retinal vessel morphogenesis, RPE development and blood-retina/brain barrier formation; the vascular-barrier context separates it from eye-morphogenesis, Wnt-secretion and planar-polarity confusables.

qualifier: in prostate luminal epithelium
name: Androgen receptor signaling in prostate luminal epithelium
rationale: All members concern androgen/testosterone response, AR-driven transcription (KLK2/3) and its restraint of prostate epithelial proliferation; androgen rather than estrogen/progesterone receptor signaling separates it from every confusable.

qualifier: peptidoglycan targeting and metal sequestration
name: Antibacterial effector defense: peptidoglycan degradation and metal sequestration
rationale: Members concern host killing of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria by neutrophil effectors, peptidoglycan-modifying enzymes and metal-sequestering proteins; the antibacterial (not antifungal or cytolytic/mucosal) focus distinguishes it from its confusables.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA signaling and glucokinase control
name: Glucagon-PKA control of glycogen metabolism and glucokinase
rationale: Members cover glucagon secretion and PKA signaling, glycogen synthesis and breakdown, and glucokinase regulation by GKRP and its MODY2 defect; glycogen and glucokinase control separate it from insulin, gluconeogenesis, ChREBP-transcription and insulin-secretion confusables.

qualifier: viral DNA integration, latency and host transcriptional silencing
name: Viral DNA integration, latency and host transcriptional silencing
rationale: Members concern retroviral nuclear import and integration, HCMV events and latency, and host silencing or activation of viral and endogenous retroelement transcription (HUSH, KRAB-ZFP, ChAHP, APOBEC3G); integration and transcriptional silencing distinguish it from confusables on HIV entry/reverse transcription or RNA-virus replication.
